pieces.Text: Your savage rage thrills the crowd as you turn it upon a foe that has harmed you.

When you spend a swift action to attempt a performance combat check while you're raging, you gain a +2 bonus on the check if the trigger involved you dealing damage to a creature that had hit you within the last round.

Situational.text: Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +3, rage class feature.
